rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Chief Cabinet Secretary's press record of the morning of 4 June 2010 says the cabinet meeting decided the resignation en masse (「内閣総辞職」について決定) and the 内閣総辞職に当たっての内閣総理大臣談話; the same record says 鳩山総理 had telephoned the mayor of Ebino that morning.

locator.section: 平成22年6月4日（金）午前 — 口蹄疫の移動制限区域等の指定について; 閣議の概要（内閣総辞職に当たっての内閣総理大臣談話）について

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same record says that 鳩山総理 spoke at the Hatoyama cabinet's last cabinet meeting (鳩山内閣最後の閣議) and that the text was handed out; the page links the 内閣総理大臣発言 PDF.

locator.section: 閣議の概要, last paragraph; 関連リンク

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In his last press conference the Chief Cabinet Secretary said the cabinet's period had run from 16 September of the previous year to 'today, 4 June', 262 days (昨年９月１６日から今日の６月４日まで、２６２日間), in the passage on the Hatoyama cabinet (この鳩山内閣が発足をし).
